The partnership integrates AI agents trained specifically on Wizz App’s content policies.
Every month, more than 20 million videos and images move through

, a social discovery platform for Gen Z who want real connections and shared experiences. Behind every one of those uploads is a young adult looking for their people. And behind every one of those uploads is a Trust & Safety team responsible for making sure they find them safely.

Committed to building a platform where every user feels safe and valued, Wizz App is taking a decisive step forward by consolidating its Trust & Safety infrastructure into Cinder, which provides mission-critical infrastructure that protects the world's most important platforms from junk, abuse, manipulation, and harm at scale.
From different providers to one unified system

"Wizz App has always put community safety first. Partnering with Cinder is the natural next step, bringing even greater speed, consistency, and visibility to a Trust & Safety program we're proud of," says Alexandra Ryabova, Head of Operations. "Cinder amplifies our safety measures, giving our teams and AI systems a unified platform to operate at their best."

Cinder also manages Wizz App's user reports and content appeals, processing reports per month through Cinder Managed Moderation, creating a seamless workflow from initial flagging through final resolution. Human reviewers and AI systems work in concert inside the same environment, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. Every decision is traceable. Every outcome is auditable.

Trust & Safety has always been at the heart of the Wizz App experience as a priority. Cinder is the next evolution of that commitment—expanding their capabilities while staying true to the community they've built.
What is AI content moderation and how does it work on Wizz App?

AI content moderation uses machine learning models to automatically evaluate user-generated content against a platform's community standards. On Wizz App, AI agents trained across its 11 policy areas review every image and video shared on the platform, flagging potential violations for human review or taking automated action based on severity.
How does Wizz App protect users from harmful content?
User reports are processed through Cinder Managed Moderation with an integrated workflow combining AI triage and human review, with every decision logged and auditable.

How Cinder Helped Black Forest Labs Launch FLUX.2 Without Compromising on Safety

was preparing to launch FLUX.2, their latest family of generative AI models, to millions of developers. Black Forest Labs is committed to preventing adversarial misuse, including to generate child sexual abuse material and non-consensual intimate imagery.

The standard model for pre-launch safety testing is sequential: assemble a team, run prompts, produce a report, hold the launch. At the pace of frontier model development, that cycle is too slow and too brittle. By the time the report is written, the model weights have changed, the fine-tune has been updated, and the findings are already partially stale.

The Theory That Cinder Carla and Honest Brute Were Former Lovers
Delusions and observations. Thoughts I had after recently playing Armored Core 6.

Cinder Carla is a woman who appears in the story. Although initially hostile to the player, she is capable of calculation and pragmatism, setting aside the past once she determines the player is a useful pawn, yet she possesses a resolute personality that pushes forward into the future without being shackled by the past. She also possesses the strength to head to the front lines as an AC pilot her

To put it simply, Honest Brute is a gentlemanly con artist. He originally served as Carla's right-hand man, but he betrayed her, caused the organization significant financial damage that could not be ignored, and stole valuable weapons before disappearing. In the story, the player receives a request from Carla to eliminate Brute to end his life.

Carla's anger toward Brute is immense. She shows a broad-minded side, laughing off even significant financial losses caused by the player, but she is consistently cold toward Brute, wishing for his death, revealing a chilling side that is unlike her usual composed self. Even after Brute's death, her reaction remains cold. Because of that coldness, it is strongly conveyed that she harbors intense a

Where does this anger come from? A theory that suddenly occurred to me is: were Carla and Brute former lovers, or did they have a close relationship? There is no evidence. From here on, it is in the realm of delusion.

Carla's desire for Brute's death can be seen as a response to someone who has crossed the line, someone she wants to disappear from this world, beyond the point of offering minimal mercy or consolation.
